_doc: 44 hobbies scored on 8 traits from -1 (opposite) to +1 (core to the hobby). cost/time: 1 low, 2 medium, 3 high. Shared with the Free Time Fortune web quiz.

hobbies.name: Rock climbing
hobbies.first_step: Book an intro bouldering session. Shoes are rentable.

hobbies.name: Trail running
hobbies.first_step: Pick a 3 km dirt loop and walk the hills. No shame.

hobbies.name: Hiking
hobbies.first_step: Find a 5 km trail within an hour of home.

hobbies.name: Surfing
hobbies.first_step: Take a group lesson on a soft-top board.

hobbies.name: Kayaking
hobbies.first_step: Rent a sit-on-top kayak for an hour on calm water.

hobbies.name: Birdwatching
hobbies.first_step: Get a free bird ID app and log 5 species in a park.

hobbies.name: Gardening
hobbies.first_step: Grow basil and mint on a sunny windowsill.

hobbies.name: Foraging
hobbies.first_step: Join a guided walk before you pick anything.

hobbies.name: Camping
hobbies.first_step: Book a drive-in campsite for one night.

hobbies.name: Scuba diving
hobbies.first_step: Try a pool 'discover scuba' session.

hobbies.name: Geocaching
hobbies.first_step: Install the app and find the nearest cache.

hobbies.name: Astronomy
hobbies.first_step: Find Saturn with a free sky-map app and binoculars.

hobbies.name: Photography
hobbies.first_step: Shoot 20 phone photos of a single color.

hobbies.name: Watercolor painting
hobbies.first_step: Get a student pan set and paint one lemon.

hobbies.name: Creative writing
hobbies.first_step: Write a 100-word story tonight, start to finish.

hobbies.name: Learning guitar
hobbies.first_step: Learn G, C and D. That unlocks hundreds of songs.

hobbies.name: Calligraphy
hobbies.first_step: Practice basic strokes with a brush pen.

hobbies.name: Journaling
hobbies.first_step: Write three lines before bed for a week.

hobbies.name: DJing
hobbies.first_step: Try free DJ software with your own music library.

hobbies.name: Upcycling thrifted clothes
hobbies.first_step: Thrift one shirt and alter it.

hobbies.name: Pottery
hobbies.first_step: Book a one-night wheel-throwing taster class.

hobbies.name: Knitting
hobbies.first_step: Knit a garter-stitch square with chunky yarn.

hobbies.name: Woodworking
hobbies.first_step: Build a simple box at a community makerspace.

hobbies.name: Baking bread
hobbies.first_step: Bake a no-knead loaf. It's hard to mess up.

hobbies.name: Cooking world cuisines
hobbies.first_step: Pick one country and cook a dish from it this weekend.

hobbies.name: Fermenting & homebrewing
hobbies.first_step: Make a jar of sauerkraut: cabbage, salt, patience.

hobbies.name: Miniature painting
hobbies.first_step: Paint one miniature with a starter paint set.

hobbies.name: Board games
hobbies.first_step: Visit a board game café and ask staff for a pick.

hobbies.name: Chess
hobbies.first_step: Play the daily puzzle on a free chess site.

hobbies.name: Tabletop RPGs
hobbies.first_step: Join a one-shot game night at a local game store.

hobbies.name: Escape rooms
hobbies.first_step: Book a beginner room with three or four friends.

hobbies.name: Coding side projects
hobbies.first_step: Build a tiny web page that does one silly thing.

hobbies.name: Puzzles & crosswords
hobbies.first_step: Do one easy crossword a day for a week.

hobbies.name: Learning a language
hobbies.first_step: Do 10 minutes a day and label things around your home.

hobbies.name: Speedrunning games
hobbies.first_step: Pick a game you know well and time one run.

hobbies.name: Yoga
hobbies.first_step: Follow a free 20-minute beginner video.

hobbies.name: Martial arts
hobbies.first_step: Most dojos offer a free trial class. Take it.

hobbies.name: Pickleball
hobbies.first_step: Find open play at a local court. Paddles are often loaned.

hobbies.name: Cycling
hobbies.first_step: Ride a flat 10 km route on any bike you have.

hobbies.name: Swimming
hobbies.first_step: Swim 10 lengths at any pace, resting when you need.

hobbies.name: Singing in a choir
hobbies.first_step: Find a community choir with no audition.

hobbies.name: Improv comedy
hobbies.first_step: Drop into a beginner improv jam. Everyone's nervous.

hobbies.name: Social dancing
hobbies.first_step: Go to a beginner salsa or swing night. Lessons come first.

hobbies.name: Volunteering
hobbies.first_step: Sign up for one shift at a food bank.
